443-640-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-640-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

215-7060-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-7060-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

34-141-2438.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-141-2438.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-3249-4549-5553.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7511.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3899-6972-7511.notes: If Witch-king starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

240-5470-7060-8095.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat from step 2.

1368-6321-6965-7763.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6321-6965-7763.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

640-2185-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
640-2185-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Howlgeist.
Howlgeist dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Howlgeist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Howlgeist, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

2388-2750-6587-7012.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Golden-Gear Colossus.
2388-2750-6587-7012.description:
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Ultimecia, Time Sorceress to become an artifact.
Declare The Golden-Gear Colossus as an attacker. It triggers, creating two 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens and transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent. It'll enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
When Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

1661-3459-3755-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

4644-5921-5970-6791.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Tidewater Minion.
Activate one of the Tidewater Minion tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Tidewater Minion token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2525-3358-6968.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

681-5413-6621-6763.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5413-6621-6763.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat from step 2.

277-681-5226-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
277-681-5226-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat from step 2.

3558-5220-5231-6900.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

972-2239-2792.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-2239-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Ardent Elementalist by paying its mana cost.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist and the Great Whale token.
When the Ardent Elementalist and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-2239-2792.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Ardent Elementalist instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

2173-5078-6890.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
2173-5078-6890.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

1322-2457-4289-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1563-2457-4094-6791.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

413-654-678-6644.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ancient Adamantoise enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1251-1563-2457-2557.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-617-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Gilded Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

2633-3940-6259.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}.
Haze of Rage's storm ability and Urabrask trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rages.
Repeat.

524-1167-1860.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4} and tapping it, causing you to gain control of target opponent during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast Aether Storm by paying {3}{U}.
As the opponent, activate Aether Storm by paying 4 life.
Repeat step 4 until the opponent has 3 or less life remaining.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1844-5434-5555-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
1844-5434-5555-5686.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 2.

222-413-527-1251.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-1251.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-6096.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-6096.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
647-3259-6096.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

413-1636-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
413-1636-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station and all creatures.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead

624-2777-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1753-4499-4747.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

331-1633-2060-3415-4120.description:
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vigor's first ability, and then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding a card at random.
Conspiracy Theorist's second ability triggers, allowing you to exile the discarded card from your graveyard if it was a nonland card and cast it from exile this turn.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Hanabi Blast either from your hand or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may instead target any other creature and/or player with Hanabi Blast.

1039-2068-2435-2652.notablePrerequisites: Apprentice Necromancer and Alloy Myr do not have summoning sickness.
1039-2068-2435-2652.description:
Activate Alloy Myr by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Teardrop Kami by sacrificing it, targeting Alloy Myr.
Ashnod triggers, copying Teardrop Kami's ability, targeting Alloy Myr.
Resolve the first Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Alloy Myr.
Activate Alloy Myr by tapping it, adding {B}.
Resolve the second Teardrop Kami trigger, untapping Alloy Myr.
Activate Apprentice Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting Teardrop Kami.
Ashnod triggers, copying Apprentice Necromancer's ability, targeting Apprentice Necromancer.
Resolve both Apprentice Necromancer abilities, returning Apprentice Necromancer and Teardrop Kami from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving them haste until end of turn.
Repeat.

2438-2661-3430-4484.notablePrerequisites:
Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich had died this turn.
2438-2661-3430-4484.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ebondeath, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {4}{B}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {2}{B}{B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Repeat.

876-1666-4896.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Angelic Protector.
876-1666-4896.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Angelic Protector.
Angelic Protector triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves ability, attaching it to Angelic Protector.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Angelic Protector, causing the opponent to lose the game due to having zero or less life.

57-1402-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
57-1402-2178.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Diamond Lion with haste.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Feldon of the Third Path.
Repeat.

936-2302-4971-5099.notablePrerequisites:
"Black" chosen with Painter's Servant.
Niv-Mizzet does not have summoning sickness.
936-2302-4971-5099.description:
Activate Niv-Mizzet to draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Mindcrank triggers, causing that player to mill a card.
Compost triggers, drawing you a card.
Repeat steps 2-4.

813-1987-2510-4792.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
813-1987-2510-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
